# VAG Scope

> VAG Scope is an Android app by mtmagicapps that reads VW, Audi, Seat and Škoda cars through a Bluetooth ELM327 adapter and checks their mileage against the control units.

- Cars: Volkswagen, Audi, Seat and Škoda using TP 2.0 (about 2004-2010) or UDS on 11-bit and 29-bit CAN ids (about 2012 and later, including MEB electric models and MQB-evo cars such as the Golf 8 generation); mixed cars work unit by unit. Reading, scanning and live data work offline on 2020+ models; online SFD unlock for protected writes is not supported because the app has no network access.
- Adapter: any good open Bluetooth ELM327 adapter (Classic or BLE on Android, BLE only on iPhone), with no proprietary locked dongle required - the same adapter works across your other cars and apps. Tested with a vLinker MC+ and vGate iCar Pro 2S.
- Features: health check (fault codes, mileage and VIN in one run and one signed PDF report), mileage check (odometer against the distance stored in each control unit), VIN check, control-unit scan and advanced identification, fault codes with freeze frames and where to look, searchable live data, dashboards (also on Android Auto), Performance Hub (0-500 km/h timing with 100 Hz OBD + phone IMU sensor fusion, virtual dyno, PNG proof cards and signed PDFs, zero GPS permission), coding, long coding, gateway installation list, adaptation, basic settings with guided functions, output tests, community procedures, four demo cars.
- Results are indicative: the app never says a car is genuine or that its mileage is correct.
- Privacy & offline: works 100% offline, even in an underground garage with no mobile signal. No network permission, no account, no advertising, no analytics.
- Platforms: Android 9 or later. An iPhone version with Apple CarPlay is planned.
- Languages: English and French.
- Price: one payment on Google Play (€9.99 in the euro zone), unlimited VINs, no subscription, no credits, no in-app purchase.
- Publisher: mtmagicapps, published by DS ECOM (France). Not affiliated with Volkswagen AG, Audi AG, SEAT, S.A. or ŠKODA AUTO a.s.

## Guides

- [Best ELM327 Bluetooth adapter for VW, Audi, Seat and Škoda](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/guides/best-elm327-adapter-vw-audi/): Pick a genuine, well-built open Bluetooth ELM327 adapter such as the vLinker MC+ (fast, reliable for coding and live data) or the vGate iCar Pro 2S (compact, affordable alternative). Avoid €5–€10 generic clones: they drop frames on VW-group TP 2.0 and UDS protocols, whereas an open ELM327 works across cars and apps without locking you into one vendor’s subscription.
- [How to check the mileage of a used VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/guides/used-car-mileage-check/): Plug a Bluetooth OBD adapter into the car and compare the odometer with the distance that other control units store (engine, gearbox, ABS and others) and with the mileage logged with each fault code. Units that agree support the reading, and a logged value above the odometer is a strong warning, but no result proves that a mileage is genuine.
- [Where to find the VIN on a VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda, and how to check it](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/guides/vin-check/): The VIN is on the plate under the windscreen, the vehicle data sticker in the boot, the stamping in the engine bay and the type plate, and many control units store it too. All of them should show the same 17 characters as the registration certificate. A control unit with another VIN usually means a used part; markings that disagree point to a changed identity.

## Compatible models (flagship guides)

- [Volkswagen Golf 5 (Mk5/1K, 2004-2008)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-golf-5/): PQ35, CAN TP 2.0. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Volkswagen Golf 6 (Mk6/5K, 2009-2012)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-golf-6/): PQ35, Mixed TP 2.0 + 11-bit UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Volkswagen Golf 7 (Mk7/Mk7.5, 2013-2020)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-golf-7/): MQB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Volkswagen Golf 8 (Mk8/CD, 2020-)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-golf-8/): MQB-evo, 11-bit & 29-bit CAN UDS. Offline reads/scans work; online SFD unlock not supported.
- [Volkswagen Passat B8 (B8/3G, 2015-2023)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-passat-b8/): MQB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Volkswagen ID.4 (E2/E21, 2021-)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/vw-id4/): MEB, 11-bit & 29-bit CAN UDS. Offline reads/scans work; online SFD unlock not supported.
- [Audi Audi A1 (8X) (8X/8X1, 2010-2018)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a1-8x/): PQ25, Mixed TP 2.0 + 11-bit UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A3 (8P) (8P/8P1, 2004-2012)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a3-8p/): PQ35, CAN TP 2.0. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A3 / S3 (8V) (8V/8V1, 2012-2020)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a3-8v/): MQB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A4 (B8) (B8/B8.5, 2008-2015)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a4-b8/): MLB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A4 (B9) (B9/8W, 2016-2023)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a4-b9/): MLB-evo, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A6 / RS6 (C6) (C6/4F, 2004-2011)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a6-c6/): C6 (4F), CAN TP 2.0. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Audi Audi A6 (C7) (C7/C7.5, 2011-2018)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/audi-a6-c7/): C7 (4G), 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Škoda Octavia 3 (5E/Mk3, 2013-2020)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/skoda-octavia-3/): MQB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Seat Leon 3 (5F/Mk3, 2012-2020)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/seat-leon-3/): MQB, 11-bit CAN UDS. Full offline read & coding, no SFD lock.
- [Seat Leon 4 & Cupra (KL/KL1, 2020-)](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/models/seat-leon-4/): MQB-evo, 11-bit & 29-bit CAN UDS. Offline reads/scans work; online SFD unlock not supported.
